newsitem.title: THAILAND: Unocal suspends Thai offshore gas drilling.
newsitem.headline: Unocal suspends Thai offshore gas drilling.

text.p: Unocal Thailand, an affiliate of U.S.-based Unocal Corp, said on Wednesday it had suspended gas drilling in the Gulf of Thailand because of storms.
But a company official told Reuters the suspension would have no effect on its overall natural gas production which averaged slightly over 900 million cubic feet per day.
The suspension went into effect early on Tuesday. A total of 635 employees have been evacuated from the offshore facilities and only 209 crew remained on board, the official added.
"This is a part of our normal safety procedures," she said.
A tropical depression had formed about 300 miles southeast of Unocal Thailand's gas fields in the Gulf of Thailand. The company operates nine gas fields in the area.
"We just received reports that the weather condition was improving. But we will continue to monitor the weather situation closely and respond accordingly," the official added.
